POWERWALL.NAME: Tesla Powerwall
POWERWALL.DESCRIPTION: Tesla Powerwall through the local API of the Backup Gateway 2 (LAN)

HOST.NAME: Gateway address
HOST.DESCRIPTION: IP address or host name of the Backup Gateway, e.g. 192.168.1.50 (https is used)

PASSWORD.NAME: Customer password
PASSWORD.DESCRIPTION: Password of the customer login of the gateway (by default the last 5 characters of the gateway serial number)

EMAIL.NAME: E-mail
EMAIL.DESCRIPTION: Optional. Sent with the login, the gateway does not check it

POLL.NAME: Polling interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: How often meters, SoC, grid status and operation settings are read

ALLOW_WRITES.NAME: Allow writing mode and reserve
ALLOW_WRITES.DESCRIPTION: Off by default. Current gateway firmware refuses operation changes for the customer login (403), the driver then logs an error and keeps the gateway's values

FINGERPRINT.NAME: Certificate fingerprint (SHA-256)
FINGERPRINT.DESCRIPTION: The gateway uses a self-signed certificate. Empty = the first certificate is trusted and stored here; afterwards only this certificate is accepted. Clear it after the gateway got a new certificate

CONNECTED.NAME: Connected
CONNECTED.DESCRIPTION: The last poll reached the gateway

SOC.NAME: State of charge [%]
SOC.DESCRIPTION: As shown in the Tesla app (the gateway's own 5 % reserve is not counted)

GRID_CONNECTED.NAME: Grid connected
GRID_CONNECTED.DESCRIPTION: false during a grid outage (backup operation)

OPERATION_MODE.NAME: Operation mode
OPERATION_MODE.DESCRIPTION: self_consumption (self-powered), autonomous (time-based control) or backup. Writable when allowed in the driver settings

BACKUP_RESERVE.NAME: Backup reserve [%]
BACKUP_RESERVE.DESCRIPTION: Reserve for grid outages, app scale. Writable when allowed in the driver settings
